description: Template-literal import globs, literal lazy imports, and a fully dynamic import() that forces conservative widening.

scenarios.name: locale-change
scenarios.description: import(`./locales/${locale}.ts`) becomes a glob edge to ./locales/*.ts.

scenarios.name: add-locale
scenarios.description: A new file matching the glob changes load.ts's dependency set.

scenarios.name: wildcard-widening
scenarios.description: registry.ts has import(name) with no static prefix, so under the conservative policy it depends on every file in its package. logger.ts has no static importer but still impacts registry.
